tonight_game.title: York Simcoe League: Aurora Tigers U13A vs Caledon Hawks

shifts.coach_notes: Clean D-to-D breakout early to establish offensive zone time, though play ends on an icing whistle.
Tigers won the D-zone faceoff cleanly and executed controlled rim breakouts to sustain extended offensive zone pressure.
Lost the center ice draw and spent heavy minutes defending the house; forwards need tighter F3 support to relieve wall pressure.
Tigers absorbed heavy D-zone pressure off a lost draw, finally cleared the zone late in the shift, but turned the puck over in transition leading to an odd-man rush goal against.
Strong push off the faceoff into the offensive zone followed by resilient defensive box-out work through a long whistle-free stretch.

After winning the opening Period 2 draw and chipping the puck deep, Tigers forwards must track back tighter through the neutral zone to deny the clean entry and slot shot that led to the 14:32 goal against.
Good wheel breakout from behind the net to transition into the offensive zone before play is whistled at the blue line.
Clean rim breakout early in the shift, though Colts regain entry and force a defensive freeze.
Strong defensive-zone battles and chip clears relieve pressure and generate late offensive-zone time.
Need stronger winger support on the half-wall to clear the defensive zone under Colts forecheck.
Multiple successful zone exits lead to offensive-zone entries before icing stops play.
Tie up the opponent center on defensive-zone draws to prevent immediate point shots.
Failed half-wall clear keeps the Tigers hemmed in and results in a minor penalty.
Tigers win the defensive-zone draw at the top dot and push up the half-wall, but play is stopped near the blue line before establishing a clean breakout.
Strong offensive-zone forecheck and blue-line holds keep the puck alive after losing the initial O-Zone draw, generating sustained 5v5 pressure until the whistle.
Tigers win the D-zone draw and absorb extended pressure before rimming the puck out for an offensive entry, but concede a goal on the counter-rush.
Step up tighter on neutral-zone rush defense to deny Barrie's quick strike for Goal #5.
Clean Center Ice faceoff win generates sustained offensive-zone forecheck pressure.
Relentless effort through a long shift draws a Barrie penalty to put Tigers on the power play.
Composed wheel breakout after an early clear allows the power-play unit to set up in the offensive zone.
After losing the opening Period 3 draw, Tigers execute a clean rim breakout into the neutral zone before defending back down low until the whistle.
Tigers clear the zone briefly via the boards, but a neutral zone turnover leads to a Barrie rush and Goal #6 against from the slot.
Tigers weather sustained defensive zone pressure, complete a rim breakout, and generate a late offensive zone entry before the whistle.
Strong D-zone draw win sets up a smooth wheel breakout; Tigers push into the offensive zone and draw a Barrie penalty at 58:07.
On the power play, Tigers struggle to establish zone time and allow a costly shorthanded turnover in front of the net leading to Goal #7.
Tigers defend inside their dots, transition up the boards cleanly, and force a stoppage after Barrie dumps the puck back in.
Barrie controls the initial D-zone draw, but Tigers stay compact in the slot and skate the puck out across the blue line before the whistle.
Clean defensive faceoff win sparks a quick breakout up ice, though play returns to the Tigers zone before an offside whistle.
Tigers win the neutral zone draw and pressure the Barrie zone before a quick counter-rush forces a goalie freeze.
Long closing shift with multiple D-zone clearances and battles along the boards until the whistle stops play with 45 seconds left.
